# Minimal native ship-page markers

The two PNGs contain only the 29x21-pixel generic GET_SHIP statistics symbol at the native asset area (1082,610)-(1111,631), cropped from the two captured terminal pages. They retain no portrait, dialogue, ship/account name, UID, balance, progression or PNG metadata. Full production screenshots remain local and are not published.

The test places each unmodified marker on a neutral 1280x720 canvas and invokes real native matching and Combat.combat_status. Existing public battle-result and EXP fixtures reproduce the EXP latch before the marker appears. The reused EXP fixture matches S rather than the live trace's B, and intermediate animation was not captured; this is a minimized state-and-marker replay, not a full video reconstruction.
